game.title: Sleeping Dogs
game.blurb: Open-world action game set in Hong Kong, in which Wei Shen joins one of the city's gangs while keeping the trust of both gangsters and police, from United Front Games and Square Enix London Studios, released 2012-08-14. RAWG average playtime: 14 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). The Steam app used is Sleeping Dogs: Definitive Edition (307690); the original app (202170) is also in the store list with the same count of 59 achievements, but its schema calls it "ValveTestApp202170". StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 1, but its walkthrough is not written: the Table of Contents lists about 45 mission pages (for example "The Beginning" and "Night Market Chase") with none written. The written subpages are "Achievements and trophies", "Controls", "Races", "Upgrades" and "Table of Contents", so it was not used. sleepingdogs.fandom.com answers the API, with about 87 linked pages, including "Downloadable Content (DLC)" and "Sleeping Dogs: Definitive Edition"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 59 achievements is hidden. The two add-on chapters use the names given in the achievement text. "Cursed Gold" and "Hell Money" name no add-on; they sit between the two add-on blocks and were put in Nightmare in North Point by position (StrategyWiki lists "Hell Shrines" as a collectible), which needs checking. "Goodie Monster" (evidence collectibles, last in the list) was kept in the collectibles chapter. RAWG also lists a Zodiac Tournament add-on, but no achievement names it.
